cadence: Every hour OX212 looks for new or changed records; a seal is closed only when there is something new to seal.

rules.tree: node = sha256(0x01 || left || right); an odd node is paired with itself

how_to_verify: Download a manifest and one of its .ots proofs into the same folder, then run: ots verify ox212-seal-<id>.json.ots (https://opentimestamps.org).
